I can answer a wide range of questions, including but not limited to:

- General knowledge and facts
- Science and technology explanations
- History and geography
- Language, grammar, and writing help
- Math problems and calculations
- Programming and coding assistance
- Advice on everyday topics
- Creative writing and brainstorming
- Current events (up to my knowledge cutoff in June 2024)
- Visual content analysis (if you provide images)

Feel free to ask anything, and I’ll do my best to assist you!
